text:
Sam: Hypothetical: if each model had a dedicated office coffee mug, what would be written on it? :coffee:
Priya: 'I am a 7B model, not a barista' — for the tiny fast ones.
Oliver: 'Ask me about my hallucinations' — for the drama queen models. :sweat_smile:
Rene: Mine would say 'Please respect my context window' with a tiny angry emoji.
Maya: 'This mug is quantized to 4-bit' — novelty mug for infra folks.
Sam: poll: react with :one: for pragmatic mugs, :two: for sarcastic mugs, :three: for existential mugs.
Priya: Also real talk, what's the worst prompt you used on prod just to see what it does? Confession thread. :zipper_mouth_face:
Oliver: I once asked a safety-tuned chat model to write a pirate-themed legal disclaimer. It politely refused and then wrote a sonnet about consent instead.
Rene: I fed a tiny LLM a full pizza menu and asked it to plan my weekend. It somehow scheduled a 3-hour nap. Not mad. :pizza:
Maya: I tried to trick a reranker with repeated tokens and it ranked my prompt higher. Felt ethically slippery.
DevBot: NOTICE: please do not run adversarial prompt experiments on production endpoints. Use sandbox cluster sandbox-phi. :robot_face:
Sam: @DevBot noted. (Also who gave the model a pirate romance subroutine?)
Priya: Can we do a sticker set? 'Respect the context window', 'Don't feed pizza menus', 'I run on caffeine and quantization' stickers.
Oliver: Someone should make a mug that says `system prompt: do your best` and slap it on the meeting room.
Rene: Imagining an HR complaint: "Model took my lunch suggestion and turned it into a haiku." I'd file.
Maya: This thread is my new morale booster. Also, can we add an office rule: no surprise prompt-testing on Friday afternoons. :raised_hands:
